empty.title: Your Library Is Empty
empty.description: Albums on your server will appear here once it has scanned them.

search.description: Find albums, songs and artists in your library.

downloads.description: Albums, playlists and songs you download play without a connection.

playlist.addedSkipped: Added to “{{name}}”. Skipped songs already in it.

autoOpenNowPlaying.label: Open Now Playing Automatically
autoOpenNowPlaying.info: Shows Now Playing when you start playing an album, playlist or song.

different.title: Switch Accounts?
different.message: Signing in as {{user}} on {{server}} erases the library, downloads and play history of {{previousUser}} on {{previousServer}} from this device. Nothing is removed from the server.

server.title: Is This the Same Server?
server.message: This device holds the library, downloads and play history of {{user}} on {{previousServer}}. Keep them if {{server}} is the same server at a new address, or erase them and start fresh.

unknown.title: Keep the Existing Library?
unknown.message: This device holds a library and downloads from an earlier sign-in. Keep them if they belong to {{user}} on {{server}}, or erase them and start fresh.
